Hi! I'm Meet, a software engineer based in Fairfax, Virginia. Welcome to my corner of the Internet, where I showcase my work, craft, unfinished or imperfect projects, and the many other things I'm exploring.

I spent nearly three years at Thomson Reuters working on SurePrep’s tax automation applications. From backend services and integration pipelines to document uploads and databases, I helped build the software behind millions of tax documents.

Now, I'm pursuing a Master’s in Computer Science at George Mason University , exploring local-first AI, LLM's, multi-agent systems, and better tools for developers.
